definitions.explanation: Indicates that something has happened before the expected time or before the current moment. More formal than もう.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{既|すで}に⟦{出発|しゅっぱつ}しました→出発：02085_shuppatsu⟧。
⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{事実|じじつ}→事実：03271_jijitsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{既|すで}に⟦{知|し}られています→知る：00458_shiru⟧。
⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{既|すで}に⟦{終|お}わっていた→終わる：00567_owaru⟧。

notes:
{既|すで}に is a formal adverb meaning "already," indicating that something has happened before the current moment or before expected.

POSITION IN SENTENCE:
Usually placed before the verb or at the beginning of a clause. Works with both past and present tense.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧: already (casual, everyday — the most common equivalent)
- ⟦とっくに→とっくに：noentry⟧: long ago, a long time already (emphatic, casual)

REGISTER:
More formal and literary than ⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧. Preferred in news articles, academic writing, business correspondence, and formal speech. In casual conversation, ⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧ is the natural choice.

WRITING:
The kanji {既|すで} is also read き in compounds:
- ⟦{既婚|きこん}→既婚：16160_kikon⟧: married
- ⟦{既存|きそん}→既存：27736_kison⟧: existing, pre-existing
- {既|すで}に⟦{述|の}べた→述べる：02389_noberu⟧: as previously stated
